name: xAI
summary: xAI is the AI division of publicly traded SpaceX, developing the Grok model family and AI infrastructure.

company: Founded by Elon Musk in 2023, xAI develops the Grok model family, with distribution through X and its own applications.
SpaceX acquired xAI on February 2, 2026, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. SpaceX completed its IPO in June 2026, so xAI should no longer be treated as a standalone private company.
intelligence.why_it_matters: xAI remains relevant to AI competition, but its economics and ownership now sit inside SpaceX. It is no longer a standalone private-company valuation comparable to the private businesses in this directory.
